regs_in_letter: FD&C Act misbranding (false or misleading); no CFR section cited in letter text

cases.cat: Broadening of indication / omission of material indication information
cases.heading: (none; body text)
cases.claim: “HELP PREVENT RSV DISEASE IN INFANTS WITH BEYFORTUS® AND SEE HOW YOU CAN AFFECT POPULATION HEALTH” | “Beyfortus is a monoclonal antibody that helps prevent RSV disease starting from Day 1 after injection.” | “Your efforts in immunizing infants against RSV disease can impact the population health burden in your community.”
cases.context: Full indication ('prevention of RSV lower respiratory tract disease') and 'RSV-LRTI' appear further down, insufficient to correct the impression.
cases.rationale: Claims suggest general prevention of RSV disease (upper and lower) while indication is limited to lower respiratory tract disease.
cases.check: Rule: compare indication phrases in headlines/body to the label indication string; flag when qualifiers (e.g., 'lower respiratory tract') are dropped.
